text:
ben: quick heads up, onboarded kumo-v2 q4-int8 on staging. small eval shows zh->en BLEU dip and a weird bracket mirror in ar samples.

mina: numbers?

ben: ran small shard:
```
./run_eval --model kumo:v2-int8 --tasks zh->en,ar->en --metrics bleu,bracket_flip --out /tmp/kumo1749
```
Top: zh->en BLEU 27.6 (base 30.4), ar bracket_flip 0.8% (base 0.0%).

sasha: ouch. any tokenization diffs?

ben: quick diff on failing zh sample shows merged ideographs in int8 that baseline split. Example:
```
baseline: [\u4e2d][\u56fd][\u7684]
int8:     [\u4e2d\u56fd][\u7684]
```
causes ngram misalign.

li: did vocab change?

ben: vocab hash identical. suspect small logit shifts change greedy path.

quant: note: this int8 build uses per-channel scale + nearest rounding. We saw tail-clipping on other models.

mina: can we run a shadow_fp32 echo to compare top-k? infra-bot?

infra-bot: @mina enable via:
```
redwood deploy update --model kumo:v2-int8 --set shadow_fp32=true
```
(heavy)

ben: started shadow run. preliminary: top-1 match 95.8% for zh first 16 tokens. mismatch clusters at ideograph boundaries and punctuation.

li: sounds like accumulator scaling. Quant team, can you try alternate rounding or widen accumulators for middle layers?

quant: will try stochastic rounding and run microbench for layers 3-6.

sasha: short-term mitigation: add a locale gate that pauses promotion if zh BLEU delta >1.0 and a detok patch to guard RTL bracket pairs.

ben: made issue #3321 with repro samples and logs. Pinning rollout until we have quant findings.

infra-bot: snapshot saved: deploy-1749998001-kumo-int8-checkpoint
